name: What specific features should I look for in energy-efficient windows for my home in Irvine or Orange?

mainEntity.name: What specific features should I look for in energy-efficient windows for my home in Irvine or Orange?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in Irvine or Orange, where summers are warm and sunny, focusing on features that minimize heat gain is crucial. Look for windows with a low Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) to block solar radiation effectively. Double-paned glass with argon gas fill and Low-E coatings are highly recommended. A low U-factor is also important for overall insulation. Vinyl or fiberglass frames offer excellent performance in this climate. These features will significantly help maintain a comfortable indoor temperature and reduce air conditioning costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Irvine or Orange, prioritize windows with low SHGC, double-paned glass with argon fill, Low-E coatings, and vinyl or fiberglass frames to minimize heat gain.
